description: This script reformats PEM files by embedding OpenSSL command outputs as comments, primarily for testing or documentation purposes.

classes.name: PemBlock
classes.description: Represents a PEM block with name, data, and comment attributes.

methods.name: Transform
methods.description: Formats and annotates PEM blocks within the input file data.

methods.name: GenerateCommentForBlock
methods.description: Generates a descriptive comment for a PEM block, using OpenSSL tools for pretty-printing.

methods.name: GetUserComment
methods.description: Removes script-generated comments from a block comment.

methods.name: MakePemBlockString
methods.description: Creates a PEM-formatted string from a block's name and data.

methods.name: GetPemFilePaths
methods.description: Retrieves all PEM file paths in the script's directory.

methods.name: ReadFileToString
methods.description: Reads the entire content of a file into a string.

methods.name: WrapTextToLineWidth
methods.description: Wraps text to a specified column width.

methods.name: EncodeDataForPem
methods.description: Base64 encodes data and wraps it for PEM formatting.

methods.name: StripAllWhitespace
methods.description: Removes all whitespace characters from a string.

methods.name: IsEntirelyWhiteSpace
methods.description: Checks if a string contains only whitespace.

methods.name: DecodePemBlockData
methods.description: Decodes base64 PEM block data after removing whitespace.

methods.name: GetPemBlocks
methods.description: Extracts PEM blocks from data using regex.

methods.name: WriteStringToFile
methods.description: Writes a string to a specified file.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to process all PEM files in the directory.
